Reliance Gen Ins. Co. Ltd vs Tahir Yousaf Khanand Ors on 15
July, 2024

Author: Rahul Bharti
Bench: Rahul Bharti
 Serial No. 9

 At Jammu

sentences.text:
Reliance Gen Ins. Co. Ltd .....Appellant(s)/Petitioner(s)
 Through: Mr. Vishnu Gupta, Advocate
 Vs
Tahir Yousaf Khanand Ors .
 ..... Respondent(s)
 Through: Mr. S. H. Rather, Advocate
 Mr. Manik Dutt, Advocate
Coram:
Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rahul Bharti, Judge

01. One Shahid Yousaf Khan came to meet a fatal road traffic accident on 11.03.2010 caused by rash and negligent driving of the offending vehicle No. JK12/1968 (Tata Sumo), which resulted in presentation of a claim petition on File on 44/Claim on 25.03.2011 by four claimants.

02. Claimant No. 1-Mohd Yousaf Khan, Claimant No. 2- Sakina Bi were the parents of deceased-Shahid Yousaf Khan whereas Claimant No. 3-Saima Kousar is widow and claimant No. 4 Khakasha Shahid is minor daughter of the deceased-Shahid Yousaf Khan.

03. In the said petition, the owner of the offending vehicle- Nazir Hussain figured as respondent No.
2, Driver-Mushtaq Ahmed as respondent No. 3 and the appellant herein as respondent No. 1 being insurer of the offending vehicle.

04. Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Poonch came to pass an award dated 31.03.2017, thereby granting a compensation of an amount of Rs. 33,86,176/- (Rupees Thirty Three Lacs, Eighty Six Reliance Gen Ins. Co. Ltd vs Tahir Yousaf Khanand Ors on 15 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/92435024/
1 Thousand, One Hundred and Seventy Six) alongwith interest @ 8% from the date of the institution of the claim petition in favour of the four claimants though without making any apportionment and subjecting the awarded amount to be granted in share as per the Personal Law of Inheritance.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
This court can say this much only that the then Presiding Officer of the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal,
Poonch acted with a very pedantic mind set by subjecting death compensation apportionment amongst the dependants of the deceased as per personal law as if it was an estate of the deceased which was being admitted to succession.
05.

Be at as it may, during the pendency of the appeal, the parents of the deceased, namely, Mohd.
Yousaf Khan and Sakina Bi died and the widow-Saima Kousar is said to have been re-married,
thereby leaving only the daughter-Khakasha Shahid to be the sole beneficiary of the compensation in terms of the award.

06. The appellant is questioning the award both on quantum of compensation awarded as well as also on its liability and intends to invoke principle of pay and recover against respondent Nos. 5 and 6.
07.
The effects of the award will now survive only to the respondent No.4-Khakasha Shahid, the daughter of the deceased, who as on now is a major and accordingly compensation may get worked out afresh.
08. Mr. Manik Dutt, Advocate is required to fetch a fresh Power of Attorney from Ms. Khakasha Shahid who is now major for representing her in the present matter.

09. Application bearing CM No. 5622/2022 is filed in which at para-2, it has been stated that Javed Yousaf Khan and Tahir Yousaf Khan, who are the two brothers of the deceased-Shahid Yousaf Khan intend to have their impleadment as being legal representatives of their deceased parents in the present case.

There is no scope for their impleadment, as the compensation awarded by MACT,
Poonch in relation to the parents of the deceased has not become an estate of the two deceased respondents given the fact that the present appeal is still pending and therefore, the application filed for the impleadment is rejected.
10. Cross objection bearing CCROS No. 03/2018 was filed by the deceased parents also shall stand abated being rendered infructuous.

11. Mr. Zulkernain Sheikh, Advocate caused his appearance on behalf of the respondent No. 6,
namely, Nazir Hussain.
Today, he is not present and, accordingly, respondent No. 6 is set ex-parte.

Insofar as service of the respondent No. 5 is concerned, his service is thus required to take place lest tomorrow he comes forward and complains about any adverse outcome of the present appeal and therefore, this Court directs the Registrar Judicial, Jammu to issue summons in the name of respondent No. 5 to Tamilat Section of District Court, Poonch, wherefrom a Process Server to be deputed for carrying out the service of the respondent No. 5 and return the process to this Court 12.
List again on 02.09.2024.
